statuses.tool_choice: Implementation normalization, not a recovered publisher specification

inventory_control.assumptions: Affine approximation, horizontal square stud grid, no roll; compensate native image-to-page aspect ratio. Yaw has axis/reflection ambiguity. Perspective is not ruled out.
inventory_control.limits: Threshold variation is not an accuracy bound or confidence interval.
